slides.head: You are not *behind.*
slides.sub: You are just early in something most people never start at all.

slides.head: You have been told to *work harder.*
slides.sub: So you did. And it made the days longer without making them clearer.

slides.head: The bottleneck was never *effort.*
slides.sub: It was that nothing had a shape yet, so every day started from nothing.

slides.head: What changes when it has a shape:
list: you stop deciding the same thing twice
the work survives a bad week
you can hand a piece of it to someone else
you can see what is missing

slides.head: A slide with no photo works too.
slides.sub: Leave *photo* out and it uses your background colour instead. Useful for a quote, a definition, or a breath between images.

slides.head: Start with *one* thing you repeat.
slides.sub: Not the whole system. The single move you already make every week, written down once so you never rebuild it.

slides.head: Pick the one thing.
slides.sub: Write it down today. That is the whole assignment.
slides.cta: Save this for the week you need it.
